mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (msg_id, from_user, to_user, group_id, content, cmd, is_read, is_offline, create_time) VALUES (#{msgId}, #{fromUser}, #{toUser}, #{groupId}, #{content}, #{cmd}, #{isRead}, #{isOffline}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, msg_id AS msgId, from_user AS fromUser, to_user AS toUser, group_id AS groupId, content, cmd, is_read AS isRead, is_offline AS isOffline, create_time AS createTime FROM chat_message WHERE to_user = #{toUser} AND is_offline = TRUE ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET is_offline = FALSE WHERE to_user = #{toUser} AND is_offline = TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE (from_user = #{userId} OR to_user = #{userId}) AND cmd = 2 ORDER BY create_time DESC
